spans.s: तुक्खार m. A race of people inhabiting the Vindhya mountain, Vikr.Ch.xviii.93.
तुषार (I) a. (f. रा) Cold, frigid, dewy, अपां हि तृप्ताय न वारिधारा स्वादुः सुगंधिः स्वदते तुषारा Na.iii.93.
तुषार (II) m. 1. Frost, cold; 2. ice, snow, K.S.i.6, Megh.i.52; 3. dew; 4. spray, especially of cold water, आचचाम सतुषारशीकरः R.ix.68, ii.13; 5. a kind of camphor.
तुषार (I) a. (f. रा) Cold, frigid, dewy, अपां हि तृप्ताय न वारिधारा स्वादुः सुगंधिः स्वदते तुषारा Na.iii.93.

तुष् vi. 4P (pp. तुष्ट; pres. तुष्यति; caus. तोषयति-ते) To be contented or delighted with anything, Bt.xv.8, ii.13, M.iii.207.With परि-, to be contented, satisfied or delighted, अस्मत्कृते च परितुष्यति काचिदन्या Bhartr.ii.2.With सम्-, to be satisfied or contented, तृष्णे जृंभसि पापकर्मनिरते नाद्यापि संतुष्यसि Bhartr.iii.5.
तुष m. The husk or chaff of grain, (अधितिष्ठेत्) न कार्पासास्थि न तुषान् दीर्घमायुर्जिजीविषुः M.iv.78.
तुस m. The same as तुष् q.v.
तुष-अग्नि, -अनल m. fire of the chaff or husk of corn.
तुष-अग्नि, -अनल m. fire of the chaff or husk of corn.
तुष-अंबु, -उदक n. sour rice-gruel or barley-gruel.

तुषार-कण m. a dew-drop, an icicle.

तुषार-गौर a. 1. white as snow; 2. white with snow.
तुषित m. pl. A class of subordinate deities, 12 in number.
तुष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Pleased, satisfied, gratified, contented; 2. indifferent to every thing but what is possessed.
तुष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Pleased, satisfied, gratified, contented; 2. indifferent to every thing but what is possessed.
तुष्टि f. 1. Satisfaction, gratification, pleasure; 2. indifference to every thing but what is possessed.
तुष्टु m. A jewel worn in the ears.
तूष्णीक a. (f. का) Silent, taciturn.

तूष्णीकाम् ind. The same as तूष्णीम् q.v.
तूष्णीम् ind. In silence, silently, quietly, without speaking, न योस्त्य
इति गोविंदमुक्त्वा
